integrity: An explicit symbolic block proof establishes the universal claim; an independent finite-field brute-force checker of small cases is embedded. No external independent mathematical audit is claimed.
limitations: The statement excludes unequal square-zero ranks and counts labeled matrices, not simultaneous conjugacy classes; exact bibliographic priority remains uncertain. Finite enumeration supports but does not prove the all-dimensional formulas.
scientific_scope: Ordered pairs of commuting maximal-rank square-zero endomorphisms on 2m-dimensional spaces over every finite field F_q, resolved by rank of their product.
title: Product-rank strata of commuting full-rank square-zero matrix pairs over finite fields
